description: Fallow quality baseline. Counters may shrink but not grow; averageMaintainability may rise but not drop. Regenerate with `npm run check:quality -- --update` (commit the diff in the same PR that moves the metric). 2026-07-18 (work-order-chaining Task 9 review fixes): averageMaintainability 90.2→90.1 — new test coverage (ChainConfigModal.test.ts, workOrderChainSummary.test.ts) plus the chainSummaryFromConfig/buildChainDetailCallbacks/createWorkOrderFromSeed changes shift the whole-project average slightly; all counter metrics (cloneGroups, duplicatedLines, complexFunctions, criticalComplexity, deadCodeIssues) are unchanged from baseline — the applyChainConfigToFrontmatter extraction (model/workOrderChain.ts) kept the new chain-frontmatter sync from duplicating TaskNoteStore's existing logic.
